newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends higher on hot weather, strong cash.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends higher on hot weather, strong cash.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended higher on Monday, boosted by reports of hot weather in the U.S. South and by reports of strong cash prices, pit sources said.
"Our market has no weather premium," a trader said. "It's been very hot in the south. Rice is going into the flowering stage. We do not need excessive heat and we've got it."
There were reports that a Mississippi River rice mill paid $10 per cwt for mid-harvest (September-October) delivery while CBOT September futures were trading at $9.57, a trader said.
Rice closed seven to four cents per cwt higher with September up seven at $9.57.
Volume was estimated by CBOT at 250 lots, compared with Friday's actual volume of 168 lots.
